title: Part V · Section 06
subtitle: Memos
introEn: Read the passage and choose the best answer.

items.passage: Questions 1-2 refer to the following memo. To all Managers, Hello, everyone. Please remember that we will be having our monthly company dinner on Friday, December 21. This month, we'll be going to the Riviolo Restaurant on 5th Avenue. Dinner will begin at 7:00 p.m. We ask you to send confirmation message to Sarah before the 19th. You may bring one guest with you. See you there, Tim, Director

choices.D: Every Christmas Questions 3-4 refer to the following memo. PARKING ETIQUETTE Each resident is expected to park directly in front of his or her apartment so all residents can have regular, convenient parking. If you have more than one vehicle, make sure you are not inconveniencing your neighbor. Please avoid parking extra vehicles right in front of someone else's apartment.

items.prompt: How often do they have a company dinner?
Where are residents asked to park?

choices.C: Letting guests park in reserved spaces
